name: Systemic Symptoms
description: Weight loss; persistent fatigue; fever; night sweats; persistent or progressive pain

name: Surface and Skin Signs
description: New or changing lump; mole changes; non-healing sore; skin changes; jaundice

name: Unusual Bleeding
description: Blood in stool; blood in urine; coughing blood; unexpected vaginal bleeding

name: Digestive Symptoms
description: Difficulty or painful swallowing; indigestion; difficulty eating; bowel changes

name: Breast Clinical Signs
description: Lump or thickening; location; size; skin or shape change; nipple change; discharge; pain; duration; progression

name: CBC Assessment
description: Hemoglobin; RBC; WBC; platelets; RBC-related indices; WBC differential

name: CMP Assessment
description: ALP; AST; ALT; calcium; albumin; bilirubin; other metabolic measurements

name: Inflammation Assessment
description: CRP and ESR; previous value; current value; date and trend

name: Imaging Method
description: Mammography; CT; MRI; ultrasound or other applicable imaging

name: Lesion Characteristics
description: Presence; location; size; shape; margins; count

name: Spread Assessment
description: Regional lymph-node findings and distant findings

name: Biopsy Details
description: Biopsy method; date; anatomical site; specimen

name: HER2 Assessment
description: IHC result; FISH result; ERBB2 signal; ratio; final HER2 status

name: Estrogen Receptor
description: ER staining result; positive percentage; final ER status

name: Progesterone Receptor
description: PR staining result; positive percentage; final PR status

name: Clinical Measurement Metadata
description: Patient; age; assessment date; source; value; unit; reference range; previous and current values; duration; progression
